verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs that the Sentry team builds and maintains for most popular languages and frameworks, with dedicated pages for Android, Elixir, Dart, .NET and others. It adds AI-native onboarding: one command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to install and configure the SDK, and an llms.txt is published. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404) for generating API clients.
